decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Flood Risk Assessment, Location Plan, Design and Access Statement, Drawing Numbers 1110/PL05, PL03, PL02, PL11 (Existing block plan only), received 18/10/11. Drawing Numbers 1110/PL12 A, PL13 A, 1110/PL15 A, PL16 A received 09/12/11.) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 9am  to 5pm on Mondays to Friday  and none shall take place on Weekends and public holidays without the prior agreement of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The windows formed in the first and second floors of the side elevation of the main building shall be obscure glazed, fixed shut and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
description: Erection of a single storey side and rear extension and a rear roof extension with two dormers and two roof lights on the front elevation of the house.
